chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Al-Muthanna, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who does not menstruate except once in three years or four years. He said: She observes a waiting period of three months, then she may marry if she wishes.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a woman who menstruates only once every three or four years?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the waiting period of a woman whose menstruation is extremely infrequent. The Imam عليه السلام rules that her 'iddah is three months, after which she may remarry if she wishes.
